instruction: Export Consul KV data filtered by prefix
Use etcdctl to watch a key with revision history
output:
etcdctl watch --rev 500 /config/app/version
PUT
/config/app/version
3

instruction: Compare and swap a value in etcd
output:
etcdctl txn <<EOF
compare:
  value("/config/app/version") = "2"
success:
  put /config/app/version "3"
failure:
  put /config/app/version-error "mismatch"
EOF
SUCCESS

/config/app/version
3
